components.name: Open marine arch bay
components.function: Need petal-roof/rib springing modules, nacre column/corner seats, shell-screen end joints and shore-platform threshold. Existing shell basin and jali motifs are source vocabulary; use shared water/dock/rocks. Coastal vines/planters/seaweed and reef fish/shorebirds proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated open marine arch bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
